brief:
The United Nations said Friday that humanitarian workers confront roughly 900 barriers to delivering assistance across the Occupied Palestinian Territory. Checkpoints, armed instability and official access restrictions have combined to create a maze of obstacles that impedes relief operations across the region.

West Bank families remain trapped as these barriers multiply, according to the UN statement. The accumulating challenges have begun to shrink the flow of life-saving aid to vulnerable populations despite continued efforts by humanitarian staff to reach those in need.
dek: Humanitarians continue to provide life-saving assistance to people across the Occupied Palestinian Territory despite facing obstacles such as checkpoints, instability and access restrictions, the United Nations said on Friday.
title: UN reports 900 obstacles blocking aid access in West Bank
